People want to know about space. We want to visit Mars next. Before we go, we need to know: ___16___ is the weather like on Mars? It is very cold there, much colder than Antarctica.
Many people have a big plan. They ___17___ send workers to Mars in the near future. However, the trip is long and not safe. We cannot go there ___18___ a plane or a bus. We need a strong ship. candidates.question: 原對話提問：「白話文」。請閱讀下方完整報告。
candidates.passage:
History Report: H Day in Sweden
Name: Lily Chen

1. What is H Day?
On September 3, 1967, people in Sweden started to drive on the right hand side. They drove on the left hand side before the date.

2. Why did the Sweden government decide to do that?
(1) In most countries in Europe, people drive on the right hand side.
(2) In Sweden, people made cars to drive on the right hand side.

3. What did the Sweden government do before H Day after they decided to do that?
(1) In 1955, they let the people in Sweden vote, and 83% of them didn't agree with the idea.
(2) The government spent four years telling people about H Day.
(3) They made new signs, new roads, and new plans for H Day. They used black bags to cover old signs.
(4) There was a logo for H Day, and people could see it everywhere.

4. What happened on H Day?
At 1 a.m. to 6 a.m., workers were busy taking down old signs and putting up new ones. At 5 a.m., the radio said to the public, “It is time to change.” To everyone's surprise, there were only 157 small accidents on H Day, and no one died. The number of car accidents and the number of deaths were lower in 1967 than in 1965. Maybe it was because people drove more carefully after the change.

Teacher's comments:（原卷此欄空白）
【原卷字詞】government 政府；vote 投票；logo 標誌；accident 意外；comment 建議。

candidates.passage:
The Aliens
Many years ago, there were some alien visitors to the planet Earth. Now the aliens are coming back, and they aren’t very friendly! Don’t see this movie by yourself if you get scared easily.
The critics say, “The special effects were great. I was so scared!” “A wonderful science fiction film!”

The Shy Boy
Roxy is in love with his best friend, Rosa. But Rosa doesn’t know it because Roxy is shy, and doesn’t tell her. This movie is for fans of romance... and a happy ending!
The critics say, “The movie was happy and sad. The ending was great.” “The story wasn’t very good, but the acting was great.”

Robot Crazy
In the city of Future, robots live with people. But one robot, Zax, turns strange and starts making a mess. Can the people stop Zax before it is too late? Laugh out loud with this robot!
The critics say, “I laughed so much. The story was exciting.” “Even if you are not a fan of robot stories, you are sure to love this one.”
